snapshot_markdown:
**Advance ZincTek Limited (ASX: ANO)** — Specialty Chemicals (Pharmaceutical-grade Zinc Oxide + Aluminum Oxide manufacturer for Personal Care sector). Perth, Western Australia. 25 employees. Founded 1997. Manufactures Alusion (aluminum oxide for cosmetics) and ZinClear (zinc oxide dispersions for sunscreen and skincare). Primary markets: US, Canada, Australia, ROW. Single operating segment: Personal Care.

## Situational read
First clean New Delta fit since A1M. This is a real manufacturer with real revenue, real margins, real IP, and a real operating system to optimize. **Business Status: Profitable.** TTM revenue $8.11M USD growing 30% YoY. EBITDA margin 32%. Net profit margin 11.4%. Net income $994K. Zero meaningful debt. 19 patent families with active filings as recent as April 2026 (rare earth nanorods, mesoporous zinc oxide powder).

But the operating environment is hostile and getting more so. In the last 9 months Geoff Acton has personally fronted: an FDA GMP compliance remediation (Nov 2025), an FDA Import Alert (Jan 2026, shares fell 3%), four separate public statements clarifying tariff exposure, and a Sep 2025 reputational scandal where ZincTek had to issue two clarifications in a single day distancing itself from sunscreen products that failed SPF testing. Through all that, they hit Fiscal 2026 Q1 sales up 27% and announced a $1.3M return of capital to shareholders in Feb 2026.

The story is straightforward: a 25-person manufacturer with growing demand, growing regulatory burden, growing reputational exposure, and one Managing Director carrying the whole stack. Geoff Acton is doing well — but doing well alone, in a regulatory environment where one more FDA letter or one more product failure misattribution could puncture the growth story. The operational system that worked at $6M revenue will not work at $15M.

## Capital structure
**Acquisition-driven, not capital-raise-driven.** No recent equity raises. IPO Feb 2005. Merger/Acquisition by **ANKLA PTY LTD** Jan 2023 for $21.40M (post-val data point of $365.85M does not reconcile — verify before referencing). Secondary Transaction Feb 2024 where an undisclosed investor sold a 12.17% stake to ANKLA.

**Debt profile is clean.** $799K total debt is 100% lease liabilities. Zero commercial paper, zero revolving credit, zero term loans, zero bonds.

**IP moat is real.** 19 patent families, 11 active, 5 pending. Top technology: mesoporous zinc oxide powder and rare earth nanorods. 2 new filings in 2025, 1 in 2026.

## Recent activity (last 6 months)
Sep 2 2025 — two public clarifications same day, distancing from the SPF sunscreen failures story. Sep 25 — first tariff statement. Oct 2 — Q1 FY26 sales +27%. Nov 16 — FDA identifies GMP compliance issues, public commitment to remediation. Jan 8 2026 — FDA Import Alert issued, shares down 3%. Feb 12 — Board announces $1.3M capital return to shareholders. April 7 — pharma zinc oxide carved out of new US tariff regime.

## Top contacts for outreach
**Primary target:** **Geoff Acton** (Managing Director, gacton@advancezinctek.com, +61 7 3726 2030). He is the operational decision-maker, capital allocator, and public spokesperson. Pitch operator-to-operator. No COO, no Quality Director, no VP Operations listed — Acton wears every hat.

## Why they'd buy
ANO is the textbook New Delta thesis at the precise inflection point where it works: a profitable, growing, IP-defended manufacturer where the operating system that got them here will not get them to the next stage. Entry points: GMP/QMS buildout for FDA remediation, working-capital discipline at 30% growth, operating model design for scale, LTO posture for regulatory resilience.

**Tier: A-tier.** Cleanest operator-fit profile since A1M. Recommend Jess prioritize for first-touch via the production/scale-up angle, with the FDA situation as the conversation opener but not the deliverable scope.
